titre: Practice test — English (6th year primary) — Term 1

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
Hi! My name is Rim. I am twelve years old. I live in Sousse with my family. I have long curly hair and green eyes. My best friend is Nadia. She is short and clever. We are both in the sixth year. Our classroom is on the second floor. I like Arabic and Science. Classes start at half past seven.

Answer the questions:
1) How old is Rim? (1,5 pt)
2) Where does Rim live? (1,5 pt)
3) What does Nadia look like? (1,5 pt)
4) What subjects does Rim like? (1,5 pt)

Complete with: am / is / are
1) Nadia ...... short.
2) We ...... in the sixth year.
3) I ...... twelve years old.
4) Our classroom ...... on the second floor.

Match each word with its opposite. Write the letter.
1) long
2) short (personne)
3) clever
4) curly
a) straight
b) tall
c) short (cheveux)
d) not clever

exercices.enonce:
Put the words in the right order:
1) friend / is / Nadia / best / My / . 
2) Sousse / live / I / in / . 
3) Science / like / I / .

Writing:
Write 3 to 4 sentences describing your best friend (name, age, what he/she looks like).
